subject: general
question: The first Finance Commission was established in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **first Finance Commission** of India was established in **1951**.
 
• It was constituted under **Article 280** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The primary objective was to define the financial relations between the central government and individual state governments.
 
• **K.C. Neogy **was the first **Chairman** of the Finance Commission.
 
• The commission was tasked with recommending the distribution of the net proceeds of taxes to be shared between **the Centre and the States.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitutional Provisions**

 
 
• Article 280 of the Indian Constitution provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body.
 
• The President of India appoints the Finance Commission every five years or earlier if necessary.
 
 
 
• **Functions of the Finance Commission**
 
 
• To recommend the distribution of net proceeds of taxes between the Center and the States.
 
• To determine the principles that should govern the grants-in-aid to states by the Center.
 
• To suggest measures needed to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State to supplement the resources of the Panchayats and the Municipalities.
 
 
 
• **Composition**
 
 
• The Finance Commission consists of a **Chairman and four other members** appointed by the President of India.
 
• They hold office for the period specified by the **President**.
 
 
 
• **Reports**
 
 
• The recommendations made by the Finance Commission are advisory in nature and are** not binding on the government.**
 
• The Commission submits its report to the President, who lays it before each House of Parliament.
